summary: Create a hard link without copying file contents.

semantics.mutation: creates another directory entry for the same underlying file

caveats: File.Copy is not equivalent: a hard link aliases the same file identity/content.
Hard links can fail across filesystems and have platform/filesystem restrictions.

tests.name: aliases same content
tests.expected_behavior: reading b observes y because a and b are hard links to the same file

tests.name: existing destination errors
tests.expected_behavior: throws rather than replacing the existing destination
